classification.difficultyReason: Identify the side opposite a marked right angle in numerical and algebraically labelled triangles.

content.prompt: Identify the hypotenuse of these triangles.

spec.description: Triangle with a horizontal top edge, vertical right edge and descending diagonal; open right-angle square at the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The legs are labelled 4 and 3; the opposite diagonal is labelled 5.
spec.answerVisibility: Side labels and right-angle mark are permanent givens. The supplied separate answer 5 is excluded from the question figure.

answer.worked: The side labelled $5$ is opposite the right angle, so it is the hypotenuse.
